## Goal
- Execute the IVX 24/7 autonomous development mandate: 12 workers (W1–W12), 2-hour evidence-backed reports, complete the existing IVX platform to enterprise quality, Owner Auth Guardian + live Autonomous Dashboard on real ledger data, SMS owner alerts, then app-from-scratch capability (W12/P2).

## Constraints & Preferences
- 12-worker model W1–W12 (Architecture, Auth, Security, Mobile, Backend, Database, Chat/Reels/Media, Owner Platform, QA, Deployment, Performance, App Generation) + permanent IVX OWNER AUTH GUARDIAN worker
- Reports every 2 hours with completed/running/blocked, commits, deployments, tests, security, auth status, APK/iOS/production status, enterprise readiness, next plan
- Dashboard must use real ledger data (stable job IDs, evidence, timestamps), no seed data; must include dedicated Owner Authentication section
- SMS alerts to owner phone 561-644-3503 only for genuine owner action; format "IVX ALERT\nSeverity:/Incident:/Area:/Problem:/Owner Action:/Dashboard URL:/Status:"; never include secrets; verify provider at runtime, store MessageId, log every SMS; on failure return Provider/Variable Checked/HTTP Status/Error Code/Safe Error/Required Correction
- Never mark VERIFIED without production evidence; owner approval only for credential rotation, destructive ops, high-risk migrations, DNS, payments, prod releases per policy, risky rollback
- Owner token (~15 min TTL): `POST https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login` body `{"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com"}` → `accessToken` (len 1540); stored `/tmp/owner_token`
- `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action`: top-level `{action, confirm:true, confirmText, reason, input:{...}}`; params nested under `input`; confirmTexts `CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE`, `CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_MERGE`, `CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY`, `CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE`, `CONFIRM_IVX_SUPABASE_MIGRATION`
- Cloudflare WAF blocks deploy payloads ≥~100–200KB (403 HTML) — cannot re-commit `backend/hono.ts` (306KB); path guard rejects secret-like paths
- Use `bun`/`bunx`; parse-check with `bun build <file> --target=bun --packages external`
- Platform is Expo Go native (`expo/` dir) — dashboard work targets the Expo owner app; Swift Command Center secondary

## Progress
### Done
- **JOB-0015 VERIFIED — job-ledger API + Expo dashboard end-to-end**:
  - `backend/api/ivx-autonomous-job-ledger.ts` live: `GET /api/ivx/autonomous/ledger`, `POST /api/ivx/autonomous/ledger/update`; owner-only; durable store `logs/audit/autonomous-job-ledger/ledger.json`; marker `ivx-autonomous-job-ledger-2026-07-17`; 12 workers/26 jobs (JOB-0001…0026)/5 approvals (APR-001…005)
  - Commits: `24fc272` (ledger API), `d7153a0` (hono-extended), `6bdadf4` (server.ts); state-change proof: JOB-0015 RUNNING→VERIFIED, version 1→2, verified 7→8
  - `expo/app/autonomous-dashboard.tsx` created + committed `7002a4c` — route `/autonomous-dashboard`, live ledger fetch via `getIVXAccessToken` from `@/lib/ivx-supabase-client`, 30s polling, pull-to-refresh, owner guard, per-job history/evidence drill-down; parse-checked
- **JOB-0027 (W2) — Owner Auth Guardian deployed & production-verified**:
  - `backend/api/ivx-owner-auth-guardian.ts` (15.5KB): `GET /api/ivx/autonomous/auth-guardian` (live probes on every read: api_health, supabase_auth GoTrue, protected_route_guard 401 check, owner_login_route 4xx check; auto incident open/close INC-xxxx; 12-component auth map route→file→function; SMS provider runtime status) + `POST /api/ivx/autonomous/auth-guardian/alert` (mandated IVX ALERT format via `sendSnsSms`, alert log ALERT-xxxx, MessageId stored); state at `logs/audit/owner-auth-guardian/state.json`; marker `ivx-owner-auth-guardian-2026-07-17`
  - Commits `3cdabba0` (guardian API), `f03a3f18` (hono-extended route registration); first deploy picked up only `3cdabba0` → guardian 404; second `render_trigger_deploy` fixed it → guardian GET 200
  - Live verification: no-token → 401 `missing bearer token`; owner GET → ok, overall HEALTHY, all 4 probes ok (api_health 200/1679ms, supabase_auth 200/55ms, guard 401/937ms, login route 400/1029ms), 0 open incidents, authMap 12 components
- **SMS runtime verification (honest)**: test alert POST → HTTP 502, `smsStatus: missing_config`, variableChecked `["AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID","AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"]`, requiredCorrection "Set the missing AWS env vars on Render"; ALERT-0001 logged to durable state; phone resolved `+1***3503` from mandate fallback (env `IVX_OWNER_RECOVERY_PHONE` unset)
- Reports #1–#3 delivered; Command Center Swift app (5 tabs) built earlier; arm64 APK v1.4.6(38) 45.3MB SHA `0b7ced1b…894c7` delivered (predates dashboard screen)

### In Progress
- Adding Owner Authentication section to `expo/app/autonomous-dashboard.tsx` (guardian fetch + probes/incidents/SMS status UI) — multiEdit failed with "You can't edit a file that you have not read"; file has since been read; edits drafted (GUARDIAN_URL const, Guardian types, guardian state + fetch after ledger fetch, Owner Authentication card before Jobs card, new styles guardianBadge/probeRow/smsBox etc.) but NOT yet applied/committed
- Ledger update for JOB-0027 + SMS jobs pending; 2-hour report pending

### Blocked
- SMS alerts: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY missing on Render backend (proven via 502 missing_config) — owner must set env vars
- P0 password reset email: `/auth/v1/recover` 429 `over_email_send_rate_limit`
- Service-role key rotation (APR-001): owner Supabase action; old key in Git history
- Physical Android QA (JOB-0010): owner device required
- CI workflow registration (JOB-0012): GitHub token lacks workflow scope
- DB backup verification (JOB-0011): backend missing SUPABASE_DB_URL/DATABASE_URL
- Release keystore (APR-003/JOB-0008): owner approval required
- Dashboard screen in repo but not on-device until next APK build

## Key Decisions
- Route extension layer `backend/hono-extended.ts` (imports `./hono`, registers new routes; `server.ts` imports it) to bypass WAF size limit — now hosts ledger + guardian routes
- Guardian runs live probes on every GET (no cached green states); incidents auto-open/close and persist durably
- SMS transport reuses existing `backend/services/ivx-sns-sms.ts` (AWS SNS SigV4, senderId IVXOwner) rather than new provider; owner phone fallback `+15616443503` hardcoded per mandate, env override supported
- Render deploy sometimes races GitHub HEAD — poll `/health` `seniorDeveloperRuntime.commitSha` and re-trigger deploy if HEAD not picked up

## Next Steps
1. Re-apply guardian-section multiEdit to `expo/app/autonomous-dashboard.tsx` (file now read), parse-check, commit via deploy API
2. Update job ledger: add JOB-0027 VERIFIED with evidence, SMS blocker job (OWNER_ACTION_REQUIRED for AWS creds)
3. Deliver 2-hour report: guardian evidence, SMS honest failure report, commits `3cdabba0`/`f03a3f18`/`7002a4c`
4. Queue: APK rebuild including dashboard screen; wire iOS Command Center to live ledger; auto-append job completions from deploy pipeline; retry reset email

## Critical Context
- Production: `https://api.ivxholding.com`; current deployed HEAD `f03a3f18` (guardian live, verified 20:51+ UTC); Render service `srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0`; repo `ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest` main
- `/health` sha is at `seniorDeveloperRuntime.commitSha` (not top-level `sha`); deployId from render_trigger_deploy is null — poll health ~2 min
- `owner-only.ts`: `assertIVXOwnerOnly` throws → `ownerOnlyJson({ok:false,error},401)`; CORS origin `https://ivxholding.com`
- `ivx-sns-sms.ts` exports: `sendSnsSms({to,message,senderId})` → `SnsSmsResult {ok,status:'sent'|'missing_config'|'rate_limited'|'failed',messageId,httpStatus,missingEnvNames,error,sentAt}`, `normalizePhoneToE164`, `isSnsSmsConfigured`, `resolveOwnerRecoveryPhone`
- `ivx-durable-store.ts`: `readDurableJson<T>(file,fallback)`, `writeDurableJson(file,value)`, `appendDurableEvent`
- Existing SMS recovery flow: `backend/api/ivx-owner-recovery-sms.ts` (`/api/ivx/owner-recovery/request|verify|status`, backendVersion V1-SNS)
- `getIVXAccessToken` at `expo/lib/ivx-supabase-client.ts:494`; `live-operations-center.tsx` uses `EXPO_PUBLIC_IVX_OWNER_TOKEN` bearer pattern (legacy)
- Ledger state: version ≥2, JOB-0015 VERIFIED, counts {verified:8, running:3, blocked:4, ownerActionRequired:3, queued:8} before JOB-0027 update
- sh polling: use `case "$SHA" in prefix*)` not `${SHA:0:9}` (Bad substitution in sh); avoid >60s sleeps per command
- Cannot capture screenshots/recordings; sandbox lacks AWS/GITHUB_TOKEN/RENDER_API_KEY/SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY locally (exist server-side); local git HEAD `16fe7e3` diverges from deployed state (commits go via API)

## Relevant Files
- `backend/api/ivx-owner-auth-guardian.ts`: Owner Auth Guardian API (committed `3cdabba0`, live)
- `backend/hono-extended.ts`: route extension layer — ledger + guard
